metadata.title: Low-Key R&B Portrait with Metallic Accents

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, low-key profile portrait of a male subject wearing a dark beanie, framed by a subtle ornate border and a blurred metallic mesh foreground element that creates a warm, golden bokeh effect.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's profile gaze directed toward the left-side bokeh element
Contrast between the deep black background and the warm skin tones
Repetition of gold/metallic textures in the foreground, jewelry, and typography
The ornate border containing the composition within a formal square frame
coreInvariants: Muted, dark color palette with gold highlights

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned in the right two-thirds of the frame, captured from the chest up in a three-quarter profile.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's illuminated face, specifically the bridge of the nose and the eye area.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the bright metallic mesh on the left, follows the subject's gaze across the face, and settles on the typography at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of deep black negative space in the background to isolate the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black for the background and clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm amber and ochre skin tones under directional lighting.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic gold for the foreground mesh, earring, and text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast in the highlights.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Classical serif with high stroke contrast
characterSpecificRedesigns: Subtle inner beveling to simulate 3D metallic depth

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed over the subject's torso area in the dark region

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stand-alone display serif for a classic, prestigious feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Classical proportions and sharp serifs that match the metallic look.
Standard for cinematic and prestigious display typography.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-key portrait of a man in a black beanie looking left. Use dramatic side lighting. Include a blurred golden honeycomb mesh in the extreme left foreground. Add a subtle, dark ornate damask border around the square frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist name in the lower third using a gold-textured, high-contrast serif font with wide tracking and a subtle inner bevel effect.

verificationChecks: Is the foreground mesh sufficiently blurred to create bokeh?
Is the typography centered and metallic in appearance?

adjustableVariables: Complexity of the ornate border pattern
mustRedesign: Generic placeholder text instead of specific artist names
Unique border patterns to avoid copyright

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp focus on the subject's face

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the subject's eyes are visible but shadowed
Check that the border does not distract from the subject
Verify the gold texture on the text matches the foreground bokeh tone
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-key portrait + Golden foreground bokeh + Ornate border + Metallic serif typography
